listing.name: Demolition Man (3DO) — pc-demolitionman (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. a 28-minute attract-mode run covering all level types and the first lightgun level/HUD; completion of the full campaign has not been confirmed. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own 3DO Demolition Man disc and Portfolio21.10 files. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own disc, generate the static ARM code and build with CMake. Start pfboot --window and follow the documented mouse or Gamegun timing instructions. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: The project reports a 28-minute attract-mode run covering all level types, plus the first lightgun level and HUD. Full campaign completion has not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
